ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: The clean twin of teastore-orderitems-meshsever-masked-001 (same stimulus, same sidecars-on deploy shape, no VS). The confirm POST returns the same success-shaped confirmed page AND both the order row and its item collection durably land: order 1386 present with 1 item (post-teardown persistence read-back + parent corroboration). With the four sidecars-on healthy probes (R1H1-4, orders 1378-1384, items 1/1 each) this leg attributes the fault twin's item-count-0 verdict to the /rest/orderitems VirtualService alone - not the temporary sidecars, the flow, or the read-back surface. Oracles must NOT fire (else FP).
